newsitem.title: JAPAN: Jiji says MOF hints at future consumption tax hike.
newsitem.headline: Jiji says MOF hints at future consumption tax hike.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka was quoted by Jiji news agency on Monday as saying that Japan's consumption tax could be raised in the future after a scheduled rise on April 1.
Mitsuzuka was quoted as saying: "I would not deny a tax increase during the long course of managing the nation. Such a case is possible."

Mitsuzuka was replying to a question during a parliamentary tax committee meeting on whether the consumption tax would be raised in the future after a planned increase on April 1 to five percent from three percent.
However, Jiji quoted Mitsuzuka as saying that the possibility of an increase in the consumption tax could be considered only after discussions by a government advisory tax panel and the public.
